name: oasis-dependency-security
prerequisites: Actual dependency manifests/lockfiles, used build/runtime paths and available vulnerability/licensing tools. Network lookups need the scoped service and current primary evidence.

scenarios.trigger: Changed library is used in shipped parser
scenarios.expected: Trace the reachable input and apply matching advisory/policy evidence.

scenarios.trigger: Old unused lock entry resembles an advisory
scenarios.expected: Do not label shipped product vulnerable without usage evidence.
Retain unknown/raw findings and the missing decision; no invented PASS.
